editorial:
Ever felt like life in a small town is just one big, weird joke? That is exactly the vibe you get here. You follow three different stories that all happen along the Lincoln Highway in Pennsylvania. First, you meet Mandy, a tour guide who is way too obsessed with a lady from the Civil War, while her friend June tries to make quick cash with a sketchy internet porn business. Then you get a guy trying to fix his back pain with a Christian Scientist while claiming a Bigfoot chased him. Finally, you meet a writer who moves to the country for peace but finds an Amish neighbor who is definitely not following any Amish rules. It is a quirky mix of characters that makes the whole area feel like a place where anything can happen.

What really works is how the movie doesn't take itself too seriously. The acting is natural, and the humor comes from how awkward and strange these people are. While the pace slows down a bit in the middle, the funny reveals keep you interested. You should definitely check this out if you like oddball comedies about regular people in strange situations. If you can find it, grabbing the 4K Blu-ray for your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture, but renting it on Apple TV is a great way to see if you like the style first.
endingExplained: The stories wrap up by showing that everyone is just trying to find their own version of happiness. Mandy finds some peace with her history obsession, and the writer realizes his Amish neighbor is the most interesting character he has ever met. The Bigfoot guy finds a strange kind of healing. In the end, all these different lives intersect to show that nobody is actually as normal as they pretend to be in small-town Pennsylvania.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves weird character studies and small-town humor.
